skill.name: postage
skill.description: Send authorized PDFs as physical US mail through AgentPostage. Check prices, status, balance, tracking, cancellations, and return receipts.
skill.summary: Send authorized PDFs by physical US mail and manage postage status, costs, tracking, cancellations, and receipts.
skill.author: ctxrs

security_audit.summary: All 89 static detections are false positives for the observed implementation: JavaScript template literals, input validation, documented API configuration, and intentional authenticated API use. The skill still creates a real operational risk because it can transmit user PDFs and spend prepaid postage, so sending requires explicit authorization, recipient review, and spending controls.

remediation.issue: Sending a letter is an external, paid side effect that can transmit sensitive PDF contents to a physical recipient.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit confirmation immediately before submission, display the sender, recipient, document name, service, and total cost, and reject missing or unverified address fields.

remediation.issue: The API key authorizes postage actions and is read from the process environment.
remediation.suggestion: Use least-privilege account keys, keep the key outside prompts and logs, restrict the base URL to approved HTTPS endpoints, and rotate keys after suspected exposure.

remediation.issue: Retries after uncertain API responses could create duplicate mailings or charges.
remediation.suggestion: Persist and reuse the idempotency key, inspect an existing letter after timeouts or server errors, and require confirmation before any replacement submission.

content.value_statement: Mailing important PDFs requires correct addresses, service choices, and reliable status checks. This skill submits authorized documents through AgentPostage and reports costs, status, tracking, and receipts.
actual_capabilities: Send an existing PDF to a US recipient using a US return address.
Check postage prices before submission when spending controls allow it.
Choose supported services, paper options, and return-envelope options.
Retrieve letter status, tracking details, receipts, balances, and transactions.
Cancel eligible letters before authorization begins.
Use idempotency keys when retrying uncertain submissions.
limitations: It requires an AgentPostage account, an API key, and available prepaid funds.
It supports US mailing workflows and does not create or edit PDF content.
It cannot guarantee delivery after a letter enters the carrier process.
A physical mailing is an external paid action that requires user authorization.

use_cases.title: Send a Formal Dispute
use_cases.description: Mail an authorized dispute PDF to a bank, lender, or credit bureau with a verified return address.

use_cases.title: Mail a Cancellation Notice
use_cases.description: Send a completed cancellation letter to a gym, subscription provider, or service company and retain its status.

use_cases.title: Track Compliance Mail
use_cases.description: Submit notices or forms, check delivery progress, and retrieve available receipts for an organization.

prompt_templates.title: Check a Mailing Price
prompt_templates.prompt: Check the postage price for the PDF at [PDF_PATH] from [SENDER_ADDRESS] to [RECIPIENT_ADDRESS]. Do not send it.

prompt_templates.title: Send an Authorized Letter
prompt_templates.prompt: After I confirm the final details, send [PDF_PATH] from [SENDER_ADDRESS] to [RECIPIENT_ADDRESS] using [SERVICE]. Report the letter ID, cost, and initial status.

prompt_templates.title: Use Certified Delivery
prompt_templates.prompt: Price and prepare certified mailing for [PDF_PATH]. Show the service, total cost, addresses, and document name. Send only after my explicit confirmation.

prompt_templates.title: Recover from an Uncertain Submission
prompt_templates.prompt: Check whether letter [LETTER_ID] exists after the previous request timed out. Do not create a replacement. If no letter exists, propose a retry with the same idempotency key.

output_examples.input: Check the price for a two-page PDF sent by First-Class mail.
output_examples.output: Price check complete. Service: First-Class. Estimated total: $1.42. No letter was submitted.

output_examples.input: Send the approved cancellation notice and report the result.
output_examples.output: Submission accepted. Letter ID: ap_12345. Status: queued. Total cost: $1.87. Tracking is available for the selected service.

best_practices: Verify the PDF, sender address, recipient address, service, and total cost before sending.
Use a price check when spending limits or service selection are uncertain.
Reuse the same idempotency key after timeouts and inspect existing letters before retrying.
anti_patterns: Do not send a document when the recipient address or authorization is unclear.
Do not place API keys, full addresses, or document contents in shared prompts or logs.
Do not submit a replacement letter before checking the result of an uncertain request.

faq.question: What does this skill send?
faq.answer: It sends an existing PDF through AgentPostage as physical US mail.

faq.question: Does it create the PDF?
faq.answer: No. You must provide the completed PDF and the required addresses.

faq.question: Can it check the price without mailing?
faq.answer: Yes. Request a price check and clearly state that no submission is authorized.

faq.question: What services can it use?
faq.answer: It supports the services and options currently accepted by AgentPostage, including certified options when available.

faq.question: How does it handle timeouts?
faq.answer: It checks for an existing letter before retrying and reuses the same idempotency key.

faq.question: What does it need to operate?
faq.answer: It needs an AgentPostage API key, prepaid funds, an existing PDF, and valid US sender and recipient addresses.
